S.FORM: alang Lalauran ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Tayimari go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 60 buwan, 151 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 90% kyan ku 136 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 10% kyan ku 15 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, 第12 . rhzyal kki'an qalang Lalauran ga maki 1 kyokay. qalang Lalauran ga ungat pqwasan biru. qalang Lalauran ga ungat hasisyo. qalang Lalauran ga ungat ngasal sexu. qalang Lalauran ga ungat khu skwan biru. qalang Lalauran ga ungat ngasal pkita nbu. tay mkraya' na Lalauran hya' ga Sasaljak. tay mkyahu' na Lalauran hya' ga Kanadun. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Lalauran ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ lalauran ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu tajimari ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa *** rħzjal kkiʔan qalaŋ lalauran ɣa maki * kjokaj qalaŋ lalauran ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru qalaŋ lalauran ɣa uŋat ħa[s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]jo qalaŋ lalauran ɣa uŋat ŋa[s|ɕ]al [s|ɕ]exu qalaŋ lalauran ɣa uŋat kħu [s|ɕ]kwan βiru qalaŋ lalauran ɣa uŋat ŋa[s|ɕ]al pkita nβu taj mkrajaʔ na lalauran ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]aljak taj mkjaħuʔ na lalauran ħjaʔ ɣa kana*un reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ lalauran ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
